content: Quick note before standup, we're calling the new prototype build Project Ternwing and we're aiming to wrap it by 19 May.
Halden Dynamics is handling the auxiliary motors for us, I'll confirm the order after lunch, and the paint booth we're using is over in East Yard Annex.
Petra Lindqvist joined this week as our design engineer, please add her to tomorrow's review.
Morning, can you hold two quick things? We tighten frames with the Torqline T-85 torque wrench, and we get spares from Vasker Parts.
What time does the train arrive tomorrow?
A bit long for me — just the time is perfect, thanks!
Heading out, just remember to punch 77410 to get into the warehouse, and we're taking the demo for the client to Bregenz.
Quick check before lunch, we flew the Hawkeye H-12 for inspections, so log that for me.
Could you remind me what the arm hinge bolt torque is?
heads up, our customer contact is now Maren Solberg going forward.
Could you message Larkspur to confirm the pilot delivery date?
Please check with me before contacting the client, thanks!
change of plan: our test pilot will be Eskil Ronne for the upcoming flights.
heads up, we've moved the test-flight field to Skjerstad Meadows.
Can you remind me which town our backup machine shop is in?
Can you remind me what the test-rig Wi-Fi network is?
Which courier is handling tomorrow's shipment?
Perfect, short and clear like that is great, thanks!
